name: Apollo Aggregates warehouse
loot: Two or three weapons on the floor
Sunglasses in the yellow toolbox outside
how: East / south-east of Hamlet. Landmark: three large rectangular pools beside the highway, with the long red warehouse just past them at the bend in the access road. Gravel yard with a striped barrier and excavators; grey door beside the Apollo trailer.
risk: Medium: guards inside, and not all of the haul is instant cash.

sources.label: GTA Vice Guides (east vs north dispute)

name: Manatee Motel
loot: Cash in a safe (reported anywhere from about $937 to $1,066)
how: South-west of Hamlet on the eastern edge of the Gullet Marsh, north-east of Cottonmouth Lake — the easternmost of the three Kingfishers sites. Top-floor room holds the variant.
risk: High: guides warn about a big cat in the area.

name: Three Sheets Liquor — parrot stash
loot: Cash hidden in an air vent
A parrot clue to the stash
how: Key Lento, just north of the Pay 'n' Spray. Go down the alley on the right of the storefront, through the broken chain-link into the exotic-pet yard. The macaw's cage marks the spot; the vent is beside the generator in the back corner. No code needed.
risk: Low once the guards are down.

name: Steven Strachan Construction
how: Sunbelt Hwy in central Key Lento, across from Sunset Dr. Use the rear entrance; the card sits on boxes next to a green container in the back room.

name: Palmer Fishing Warehouse
loot: Safe code written on the ground-floor computer
how: Bobcat Key, off Watson Bay — south end of the key. The safe is upstairs in the lounge corner; read the code off the computer downstairs before you go up.
risk: Very high: a full fight, best left until after Chapter 1.

name: Permit Keys wrecks
how: Two different islands. The suppressed pistol is in a deck hatch on the Derelict Spy Vessel wreck at the southern tip of the south-eastern Permit Keys island; the shotgun lies on the sand beside a tilted boat on the northernmost island. A boat or jet ski is required.
risk: Low, but the swim is the hard part.

name: Wetman Bay fishing shacks
how: The middle island in Wetman Bay — west of Pelican Valley and north-west of Key Lento. The W-22 sits in a case on the kitchen counter of the salmon-red main house over the dock.

name: Pelican Valley research outpost
loot: $10,000 in marked bills in the boathouse
how: A medium island in the south-west Pelican Valley swamps, just north of the Keys and south-west of the Pelican Valley label. Boat only. 0072 is the safe; 0212 is the boathouse keypad.

name: Abandoned site north of the airstrip
how: North-east of Cottonmouth Lake and south of Hamlet, at the north end of the long airstrip between the lake and town (one guide calls it South Point Airfield, east of the Manatee Motel). The keypad code is dream-derived and can differ per save — 2314 is the commonly reported one.

name: Kingpin Bowling safe
how: Southern Port Gellhorn on US-9, just south of the Pawn & Gun. Safe is in the back office; the three Port Gellhorn codes are all written on the wall map at Brooks Boatworks.

name: Brooks Boatworks
loot: Safe upstairs in the main warehouse
The wall map listing all three Port Gellhorn codes
how: Northern Port Gellhorn waterfront, the docks near the bridge to Draper Island. Enter through the hole in the east fence, climb the grey building's outside stairs to the room with the wall map — that map gives you 6823, 6969 and 0300 in one go.

name: La Cascara Motel
how: Western Port Gellhorn shoreline on Draper Bay, just south of the rail bridge to Draper Island and south-west of Brooks Boatworks, near Wild Hog Point. The gated top-floor room is the point of the visit.

name: The couch in the tree
how: Tanglewood Ln in Port Gellhorn, outside a mobile home. A couch is hanging from a tree — shoot the ropes to drop it, then search it. Pure free-roam pickup: no mission, no robbery, no cash.

name: Meteorite at Hillside Campsite
how: Eastern side of Mount Kalaga National Park, near Hillside Campsite south-west of Dawson Dam. Purple smoke marks the spot, roughly halfway up the trail. Backcountry roads only — take something with clearance.
risk: Low, but it is a long walk out if you wreck a vehicle.

name: Dog Island — jet-ski dog
how: Ride Cool Dog's jet ski and stay on it — the dog leads you to the island south of Bobcat Key. An upturned boat marks the landing. (Not the same place as the SOS islet far west in Leonida Bay, which is still unconfirmed on the map.)

name: Glider in the treeline
how: Bobcat Bight, the northern tip of the Mariana coast, in the treeline by the water. A powered paratrike is hung in a pine — shoot the lines to bring it down, then take the pistol off the seat.
